90a29bd14d19b23d1edb.text: Bias – means a tendency to favor a person, group or thing or point of view over

a0d9b403d6b783a6ec32.text: another, often in an unfair way. Example: Female teachers give more attention to girls.

1ac6bdb156c218f583a0.text: Prejudice – is an unfavorable opinion or feeling formed beforehand or without

0095518cf0edb68e92e8.text: knowledge, though or reason. It simply means pre-judge others. Example:

a40e3556f0180372b68e.text: It is sometimes assumed that someone who is physically disabled is also mentally disabled.
